text:
tara-cs: Customer (acme-corp) reporting huge latency spikes and responses served from the wrong region — responses show header X-geo: us-west and p95 latency ~800–900ms. They also saw intermittent 401s. Hitting /v1/complete.
anna-support: Can you repro locally? Customer says it started around 2026-03-16T10:12:00Z.
tara-cs: Here's the curl they're using:
```
curl -i -X POST "https://api.redwood.com/v1/complete" \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"model":"rwd-7b","prompt":"hi"}'
```
jason-sre: Looking at edge logs for org=acme-corp, I see a cluster of requests routed to us-west between 10:10-10:18 UTC. Route table shows a stale mapping in proxy cache for that org. Hypothesis: routing cache TTL not invalidated after config push.
mike-eng: We did a region-routing cache change in the proxy last night (rollout r12345). Could be related. Repro steps I just ran: set Cookie: rw_region=eu-central and call /v1/complete -> still returns us-west.
lucy-ops: Rollout r12345 was applied at 03:05 UTC (internal deploy log). No rollback triggered.
kevin-platform: Looking at capacity metrics: eu-central had a capacity dip at 10:09-10:15 UTC (autoscaler snafu) so fallback to other regions was expected. But fallback path should add header X-fallback and notify client. Metrics show X-fallback header missing for this org, so client couldn't tell it was cross-region.
jason-sre: Logs show proxy skipped setting X-fallback when a sticky cookie (rw_region) is present. That code path probably assumed cookie implies client preference and never annotated. That's a bug — should still emit fallback annotation.
mike-eng: Created quick patch to ensure X-fallback is set whenever fallback happens, regardless of cookie. I can push a hotfix to proxy fleet.
anna-support: Customer impact: higher latency + additional egress charges for cross-region traffic. CS has opened billing ticket and asked for goodwill credit while you patch.
tara-cs: Temporary mitigation suggested to customer: set explicit header `X-Region: eu-central` on requests — that forces correct region selection and bypasses sticky-cookie path. They confirmed it reduces latency. We also provisioned an emergency capacity bump for eu-central.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rollout r12345-v2 -> proxy-hotfix started at 1865554360
mike-eng: Hotfix merged and rolling. Patch ensures X-fallback present and fixes cookie-check logic. Will monitor for misroutes.
jason-sre: Action items for postmortem: 1) revert risky routing-change pattern and add canary phase; 2) add metric for "routing-mismatch-rate" (header mismatch vs. routing decision) and an alert if >0.5% for 5m; 3) ensure autoscaler doesn't report zero capacity during transient healthy cycles; 4) automatic rollback if >1% user-visible misroutes in canary.
anna-support: Will coordinate billing credit and customer comms, add to support notes.
tara-cs: Thanks — please update when metrics are green. Last seen customer latency normalized at ~120ms at 10:20 UTC after explicit header and capacity bump. Closing once SRE confirms stable.
